title: Codex usage
description: Local signed-in CLI quota snapshot; account authentication stays on the collector host. Requires the included local Python collector on a Mac already signed into Codex; uses a private server-side source credential. Setup: see this package's INSTALL.md in the public source release. Add an approved public source URL before submitting. Configure actual service URLs and credentials locally after import; never upload them to Workshop.
changelog: Initial public release; portable example URLs and documented local setup.
